start.lead: Open a GBA game to try native video, audio, controllers, speed and states.
start.hint: No games at hand? Use {path}: the screen is magenta and turns green while you hold A.

menu.label: Quick menu
menu.turboHint: Hold {key} for turbo. Audio is muted in fast forward.
menu.savesHint: {save} saves and {load} loads slot 1, even with the menu closed.
menu.videoCompare: Compare smoothness and latency of the two paths.
menu.videoNoNative: Native video is not available on this system.

errors.unsupportedFormat: EmuDome can't open .{ext} files. Choose a GBA game (.gba, .gb, .gbc).
errors.consoleNotYet: {console} support arrives in Phase {phase}. For now, open a GBA game.
errors.coreNotFound: Core {file} not found. Run scripts/fetch-cores (see the README) or set EMUDOME_CORES_DIR.
errors.openFailed: Couldn't open the game. Check that the file is a working GBA game. Details: {detail}
errors.noGame: No game is open. Open one first.
errors.nativeVideoUnavailable: Native video isn't available on this system. Keep using “In the webview”.
errors.webviewBackgroundFailed: Couldn't change the interface background: {detail}. Try again.
errors.slotEmpty: Slot {slot} is empty. Save to it first.
errors.stateSaveFailed: Couldn't save to slot {slot}: {detail}. Check that the save folder is writable.
errors.stateLoadFailed: Couldn't read slot {slot}: {detail}. Try again or use another slot.
errors.stateInvalid: The state in slot {slot} doesn't fit this game or this core version. Save it again.
